channel.title: Lavkush Gupta — Blog
channel.description: Case studies, field notes and the occasional vlog by Lavkush Gupta.

item.title: Self-Attention from Scratch: Building the Transformer's Engine in Plain Python
item.description: Build scaled dot-product self-attention with nothing but lists and a square root, then read the attention weights as it learns that 'cat' and 'mat' belong together. Q, K, V decoded with a dating-app analogy. No PyTorch, no NumPy required.

item.title: Why Transformers: From One-Word-at-a-Time to the Group Chat
item.description: Why the world dropped RNNs for Transformers, explained with a kitchen, a group chat, and short runnable Python, including a self-attention pass that resolves a pronoun on a real sentence. No PhD, no PyTorch.

item.title: Linear Algebra Intuition: Why Every AI Model Is Just Matrix Math
item.description: A 5-minute, STAR-format walk through vectors, matrices, dot products, rank and projections: the geometric intuition behind every neural network, plus plain-English Q&A and paper exercises.

item.title: PM2: The Tool That Quietly Solved Multiple Problems for Me
item.description: How I went from juggling terminals, crashed processes and manual server restarts to a workflow that mostly takes care of itself.

item.title: Welcome: a new home for my notes & case studies
item.description: I rebuilt this site in a minimal, Bear-inspired style, and it's now also home to my case studies, notes and the occasional vlog.
